subject: POC resource recalibration request — extended context & burst TPM
messages:
From: Amira Gomez <amira@sierralabs.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC sizing — need higher starter credits and longer trial

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the fast demo earlier this week. The team dug into the integration and we realized the POC scope is bigger than we first estimated. Two things driving this:
- We need 1.2M token horizon support for long-document summarization (averaging 600k tokens per doc during ingestion).
- The frontend will generate bursts of 250–400 TPM during business hours as multiple analysts run batch queries.

Current self-serve credits are not going to be sufficient to show an end-to-end result. Can you approve an uplift of initial free credits to cover ~30M tokens over the next 30 days and extend the trial by an extra 30 days?

I've attached a rough usage/cost estimate so you can see the traffic shape. Procurement is on standby, but we wanted to exhaust the PLG path before jumping to a contract.

Regards,
Amira
Head of Data Products
Sierra Labs
[Attachment: Sierra_POCCost_Estimate.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Subject: Re: POC sizing — need higher starter credits and longer trial

Amira — thanks for the estimate and the clear traffic notes.

We can often handle larger POCs via a temporary self-serve credit uplift, but I need to confirm a few internal details first (SLOs, monitoring, and security evidence). Looping in Marissa (CS) to own customer onboarding and Laura (manager) and Karthik (SE) to validate throughput and cost.

Action items:
- Marissa: prepare a short onboarding playbook and set up the sandbox access with usage dashboards.
- Karthik: please sanity-check the token math and whether we should recommend a quantized model variant for cost relief.
- Laura: need an OK for an elevated, time-bound credit issuance (30M tokens, 30 days) and whether to require procurement contact to be provisioned concurrently.

Amira — I expect to get back to you within 48 hours.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_excerpt.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC sizing — need higher starter credits and longer trial

Quick read from the SE side: the usage profile is unusual but doable. Notes:
- 1.2M token window: we have compatible model variants (q8b) that preserve reasonable quality; recommend switching to a 16k+ chunked streaming pipeline for ingestion with prefix caching for repeated queries.
- Burst TPM: 400 TPM sustained is fine on Dedicated pools; for Hosted/self-serve we should add a soft throttle and a monitoring alert at 200 TPM to prevent runaway costs.
- Cost estimate: 30M tokens at the q8b profile + caching roughly maps to a $2.8k–$3.6k spend (hosted) for the 30-day window.

I recommend issuing the uplift as a time-bound credit (30 days) with automatic telemetry to our console. If they hit 60% usage within the first 10 days, auto-flag for a solutions call to discuss moving to Dedicated.

Happy to pair on configuration.

—Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC sizing — need higher starter credits and longer trial

Thanks everyone. Based on Karthik's estimate and the SOC2 snippet that Priyom attached, I'm comfortable approving a one-time self-serve credit uplift:
- 30,000,000 free token-equivalent credit
- 30 day extension to the trial window
- Soft limits: 200 TPM alert; 400 TPM hard cap with auto-failover to reduced-quality model if cap is hit
- Monitoring: Marissa to provision the project dashboard and enable usage alerts to both the Sierra Labs team and our CS escalation channel

Condition: procurement should be copied on the final email and given DocuSign starter for a subsequent MSA/Order Form if they want to convert earlier than the 30 days. Priyom — please notify Amira and attach any onboarding links.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales (EMEA & US)
Redwood Inference

- 30,000,000 token-equivalent credit applied to Sierra Labs' self-serve account (auto-applies to your project).
- Trial window extended by 30 days from your original signup date.
- Runtime controls: soft alert at 200 TPM; enforced hard cap at 400 TPM with automatic fallback to the cost-optimized q8b variant if exceeded.
- Automated telemetry: usage dashboard and alerting shared with both your team and our CS rotation.

Next steps for Sierra Labs:
1) Access the POC dashboard and usage view: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/sierralabs/poc-usage
2) Onboarding playbook and quick setup call (Marissa will send a Calendly).
3) Procurement: if you want to convert to an order form earlier, reply and we'll start a DocuSign flow.

Attachments included for your records: Sierra_POCCost_Estimate.xlsx, SOC2_excerpt.pdf

If you hit >60% of the credit within 10 days we'll schedule a technical review to help size Dedicated capacity.

Thanks — excited to see the PoC results.

Best,
Priyom Das
